messages.author: 334c7505e0b5cf65
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] R-INLA clustering
parts: I am seeking to do clustering using R-INLA. Is there any packages allow to do clustering with R-INLA?

You could use INLA to fit a ‘mixture' to the data [1] [2], if that is what you mean by clustering. In general, INLA will be able to fit a model conditional on the classification, which can then be exploited for clustering. But this can be slow if you need to explore a large number of possible classifications. See [3] for a faster alternative, but the methodology still needs to be better framed theoretically, I am afraid. In [4] you will find an application to cure rate models which seems to work fine in practice.


[1] https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11222-017-9778-y
[2] https://becarioprecario.bitbucket.io/inla-gitbook/ch-mixture.html
[3] https://arxiv.org/abs/1712.09566
[4] https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11749-019-00679-x
